name: Giant Bomb
description: A massive bomb with configurable spawning behavior, triggered by a room-local variable.

fields.name: Spawn Time
fields.description: The time until the bomb spawns. Only used when Spawn Type is Growing.

fields.name: Text Info
fields.description: Determines the text displayed at the bottom of the screen.

fields.name: Spawn Type
fields.description: Determines how the bomb spawns and behaves.

0.name: Timer, Growing
0.description: The bomb grows until the spawn timer reaches zero.

1.name: Triggered, Drop
1.description: Falls from the sky when the trigger variable is activated.

fields.name: Trigger Variable
fields.description: The room-local variable that triggers the bomb's behavior when set to true.
